unit.title: A Testable Compiler Vertical Slice
unit.learner_profile: A strong algorithms student who is building practical software-engineering habits
unit.scope: Specify, implement, and test a deterministic compiler for a unit-local one-function language, producing a unit-local textual IR.
learning_objectives: Turn a small language contract into an end-to-end compiler pipeline.
Separate parsing, representation, emission, and command-line concerns well enough to support change.
Define deterministic success and failure behavior at a process boundary.
Build repeatable positive and negative tests and preserve concise execution evidence.
Distinguish a manager-authored exercise from the unavailable upstream SysY, Koopa IR, and RISC-V specifications.
required_deliverables: A runnable compiler implementation and documented entry point
Automated tests for the specified valid and invalid input partitions
README.md with reproducible build and test commands
DECISIONS.md recording boundaries, invariants, and one planned extension
EVIDENCE.md containing commands, environment facts, and captured outcomes
out_of_scope: Claiming conformance with the official SysY language or Koopa IR
Optimization, variables, expressions, control flow, functions beyond main, or recovery after multiple syntax errors
Reconstructing the upstream nine-step course sequence

completion_policy.decision_authority: A worker-harness-controlled validator applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md to durable submitted artifacts and execution evidence.
required_evidence: The documented clean build and test commands execute within their bounded timeouts.
Observed valid and invalid cases satisfy the task contract.
The rubric threshold and every critical gate are satisfied.
completion_policy.course_completion_rule: This preparation job defines no whole-course completion route. Later jobs must verify upstream materials, expand and validate additional units, and establish a separate course-level completion decision.
completion_policy.failure_policy: Retain failed-attempt artifacts and validation evidence; do not promote the unit on prose claims or partial output.

provenance.basis: The catalog snapshot embedded in JOB.md; no remote material was retrieved.
provenance.claim_limit: The snapshot supports course identity and broad goals only; it does not establish official lesson order, exact language/IR rules, assessment rules, or availability of linked content.
